rationale: Correct Evolve's predecessor identity, Stonepeak ownership chronology and current asset perimeter. Preserve the 2015 preferred investment, the 2020 transfer of GP control and the 2024 elimination of the public float without treating sold or dissolved projects as current assets.

supports: Stonepeak's $350 million preferred investment closed October 14, 2015
The investment was private equity rather than debt-only exposure
Stonepeak acquired GP control on September 7, 2020
The 2024 limited call eliminated the unaffiliated public float
Stonepeak continues to list Evolve as a current investment
Evolve remains an operating U.S. midstream platform

companyFieldUpdates.subsector: Natural gas gathering, processing and transportation
companyFieldUpdates.description: Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP is a private, Stonepeak-controlled U.S. midstream platform whose current disclosed operating perimeter comprises the Catarina gathering system and the Seco pipeline in South Texas. Stonepeak entered through a $350 million private preferred-equity investment in 2015, acquired general-partner control on September 7, 2020 and obtained all remaining economic interests when the unaffiliated public float was cashed out on February 16, 2024. Carnero, HOBO and Levo are former, terminated or dissolved investments and are not current Evolve assets.

set.event: Constellation formed the partnership that later became Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP.
Stonepeak closed a $350 million private preferred-equity investment; the separate Catarina asset purchase was approximately $345.8 million.
Stonepeak acquired Evolve's general partner, incentive distribution rights and sponsor common interests, obtaining control of the partnership.
Stonepeak completed the limited call, cashed out the unaffiliated public float and obtained all remaining economic interests; public trading ended.
